currentContext.business: The company was incorporated in 1987 as Bansisons Beverages Private Limited, was later Essel Tea Exports Limited and then Bansisons Tea Industries Limited, and was renamed Novyra Pharmachem Limited on 19 January 2026. Its main objects were amended during the year to cover manufacturing, formulating, processing, blending, importing, exporting and trading in pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients, intermediates, fine and specialty chemicals, bulk drugs, formulations and nutraceuticals, together with research laboratories, pilot plants and CMO/CDMO/CRO activity. The Board's Report states the company now has three reportable business segments - Pharma, Real Estate and Tea Estate - and that it is striving to establish itself in the market following the shift of its registered office from West Bengal to Gujarat.
